about: Which group each file belongs to (ADR 0008, docs/upgrade-notes.md), and the Template's repository name. A file matching no pattern is a Baseline file; the drift check skips the ignored ones. Patterns are repo-relative globs for Node's path.posix.matchesGlob: '*' matches within one path segment, a final '/**' matches everything below a folder.

feature.what: Every Feature's folder, including its rules fragments

projectOwned.what: The app identity and sign-in methods
The Project docs: its glossary, ADRs, agents file and any other docs of its own

ignored.what: Specs and tickets: scratch work, cleared now and then, e.g. before a Project's first Feature
